title: Pure Relinquished
summary: Relinquished and the Eyes Restrict cards, with generic Ritual and Fusion staples; the page's Kaiju slingshot is left out. Every Eyes Restrict monster absorbs one of their monsters as an Equip Spell and takes its ATK, so the deck removes threats without destroying them. Nightmare-Eyes Restrict, the 2026 card, is the first Eyes Restrict Fusion that doesn't need Relinquished. It equips one of their monsters when summoned and again after each battle, and their monsters can only attack it. Relinquished Fusion fuses on either turn by banishing materials and later equips another monster from the GY. Millennium-Eyes Illusionist does the same from the hand and returns whenever an Eyes Restrict is summoned. Instant Fusion summons any of the Level 1 Fusions straight from the Extra Deck. Pre-Preparation of Rites searches Black Illusion Ritual and Relinquished together.

exclude.Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion: Not released in the TCG yet.

exclude.Sacrifice Level-Up: Tagged Relinquished, but it ranks up an Xyz Monster and the deck has none.
